profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Aerospace & Defense
profile.summary: I develop, maintain, and enhance software systems used for the ground simulation testing of DOD Aircraft models, Missile Systems, and Space Systems. I design flight control software and real-time data acquisition systems using C/C++, C#, and Fortran to improve operational efficiency, security and reliability to 100%. I seek to fulfill all demands of the National Defense Strategy.

projects.title: Pantry Pro
projects.description:
Designed a Java Based Android Application from scratch in Android Studio with a party of 3. As a team, we integrated a cloud-based database called Firebase into the application to store data such as items in a pantry, grocery lists, and food recipes and then allowed user permissions to edit if needed. This project was worked on remotely where communication was through Slack.

This project was created by Benjamin Wright, Zac Cianflone and Kylor Kersavage. Development of the App took place from April 2016 - July 2016. All programmed in Android Studio using the Java Object-Oriented Programming language. A video can be found at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m9T-IS5-7hs&feature=youtu.be

projects.title: XmasWishlist
projects.description: Developed a Java Web Application using AWS with a party of 4. Designed to allow users to create a Christmas Wish List application. Users can create an account and sign in to view Christmas Lists made by themselves or by other users. Items added to a list contained links to Amazon to explain more information on the product. This would give viewers a way to locate an item they wish to get for another user. All data was stored on a secure RDS database. Website was hosted on Amazon Web Services.
